why_it_wins: It makes the plate travel carry the whole story: table -> almost kitchen -> paused idea -> silently across to her -> deadpan pause -> stacked back to him -> kitchen.
core_rule: Storyboard first. Text belongs only as context, thought bubble, speech bubble, or deliberate silence inside the scene.

visual_system_candidates.name: Silent Plate Ping-Pong
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Best preserves ordinary daily human behavior. The plate movement is the story.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Needs precise expressions, hands, phone, and plate staging.

visual_system_candidates.name: Kitchen Is Too Far
visual_system_candidates.risk: Can become a one-note distance gag.

visual_system_candidates.name: Dinner Table Standoff
visual_system_candidates.risk: Can feel like conflict or chore debate.

rejected_visual_patterns: one static angle for all slides
camera_plan: Scene 3: tight pause from kitchen to her plate
Scene 6: close stacked plates plus phone reach

aspect_plan.instagram_post_4x5: Keep hands, plates, phone, and faces readable; reduce excess vertical/table space.
aspect_plan.reels_stories_9x16: Use vertical room depth: table foreground, kitchen background, standing/walking action on slide 7.
aspect_plan.text: Use small integrated handwritten text cues; never large quote-card captions.

identity_reference_requirement.rule: Final proof and final slides must use the identity reference as actual visual input before any image is judged.
